name: Cylindrical Projection for Volumetric Approximation
definition: A technique for approximating volumetric medical data (CT images) by projecting samples onto a cylindrical surface centered on a region of interest (e.g., vasculature), which is then texture-mapped onto a 3D cylinder for real-time rendering with parallax effects.
summary: Cylindrical Projection for Volumetric Approximation is a two-step technique that projects volumetric data onto a cylinder to enable real-time, multi-view rendering without re-casting.
